titulo_fr: Lire un menu : Repérer les informations
intro: It identifies simple dishes, drinks and options in a coffee-shop menu. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It identifies simple dishes, drinks and options in a coffee-shop menu. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention: « Avec » introduces accompaniments and « ou » presents an alternative; prices are read next to the dish. In this fragment, «menu» means «menu».

frases.fr: La soupe du jour est aux légumes et coûte six euros.
frases.es: La sopa del día es de verduras y cuesta seis euros.
frases.en: The soup of the day is of vegetables and costs six euros.

frases.fr: Le menu comprend une salade ou un sandwich, avec une boisson.
frases.es: El menú incluye una ensalada o un sándwich, con una bebida.
frases.en: The menu includes a salad or a sandwich, with a drink.
